tool.name: OGS: generateGeometry
tool.description: Galaxy wrapper for the OGS utility 'generateGeometry'.
tool.command: generateGeometry #if str($z0) --z0 '$z0' #end if #if str($y0) --y0 '$y0' #end if #if str($x0) --x0 '$x0' #end if #if str($z1) --z1 '$z1' #end if #if str($y1) --y1 '$y1' #end if #if str($x1) --x1 '$x1' #end if #if str($nx) --nx '$nx' #end if #if str($nx1) --nx1 '$nx1' #end if #if str($ny) --ny '$ny' #end if #if str($ny1) --ny1 '$ny1' #end if #if str($nz) --nz '$nz' #end if #if str($nz1) --nz1 '$nz1' #end if #if str($geometry_name) --geometry_name '$geometry_name' #end if #if str($polyline_name) --polyline_name '$polyline_name' #end if --output output_1.gml

param.label: z0
param.help: z coordinate of the first point

param.label: y0
param.help: y coordinate of the first point

param.label: x0
param.help: x coordinate of the first point

param.label: z1
param.help: z coordinate of the first point

param.label: y1
param.help: y coordinate of the first point

param.label: x1
param.help: x coordinate of the first point

param.label: nx
param.help: number of subdivisions in x direction

param.label: nx1
param.help: number of subdivisions in x direction

param.label: ny
param.help: number of subdivisions in y direction

param.label: ny1
param.help: number of subdivisions in y direction

param.label: nz
param.help: number of subdivisions in z direction

param.label: nz1
param.help: number of subdivisions in z direction

tool.help: This tool runs the **generateGeometry** utility from the OpenGeoSys suite.
